description: Retinal fundus photography prompt templates for MedTEC-Bench levels 1-6. Source dataset: ODIR-5K (Ocular Disease Intelligent Recognition). Per-eye single-label filtering against the Left/Right-Diagnostic Keywords columns, target ~150 images per category. The 'Other' (O) bucket is dropped because it is heterogeneous (laser spots, drusen, optic atrophy, vein occlusion, etc.) and would dilute fine-grained probing.
